**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all three production regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002. The SEV2 incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up.
